name: Self Healing Web Scraper and Autonomous Browser Agent
category: Autonomous Browser Automation and Web Data Extraction
framework_pattern: Deterministic First Playwright Controller with Vision LLM Fallback and Self Healing Locator Cache
author: Antigravity Agentic Workflows Vault (Cole Medin Pattern)
description: High performance async Playwright scraper with stealth anti bot evasions, deterministic fast path cache execution, micro timeout error interceptor, Gemini Flash multimodal spatial grounding, and persistent ARIA selector cache updater.

pillar_1_controller.name: Browser Controller
features: Isolated browser contexts and custom user agents
Deterministic fast path selector queries with micro timeouts
Zero token overhead during standard operational runs

pillar_2_watchdog.name: Error Interceptor
features: Traps PlaywrightTimeoutError and DOM element resolution failures
Prevents pipeline termination and freezes active page context
Captures lossless PNG viewport screenshots for multimodal inspection
Routes failure diagnostics directly to Vision Fallback Node

pillar_3_vision.name: Vision LLM Fallback Node
features: Lossless image inspection with zero raw DOM parsing overhead
Spatial bounding box grounding scaled 0 to 1000
Extraction of visible text and ARIA accessibility semantics
Strict Pydantic schema validation for structured JSON resolution

pillar_4_cache.name: Dynamic ARIA Selector Cache Ledger
features: Domain and field key hierarchical indexing
Prioritization of accessibility roles and visible text over brittle classes
Success and failure hit rate telemetry tracking
Sub second deterministic execution on all subsequent runs

browser_config.user_agent: Mozilla/5.0 (X11; Linux x86_64) AppleWebKit/537.36 (KHTML, like Gecko) Chrome/128.0.0.0 Safari/537.36

GEMINI_API_KEY.description: Google Gemini API key for multimodal spatial grounding. If absent, engine engages heuristic fallback.

GOOGLE_API_KEY.description: Alternative environment variable for Gemini API key.

PLAYWRIGHT_HEADLESS.description: Set to false to display Chromium GUI window during development.

SELECTOR_CACHE_FILE.description: Custom file path for persistent selector cache ledger.
